column1: # target: learnsets of every national form entry, resolved by the chain Z-A > SV > SWSH > older

# source: EXTERNAL/PROBABLE, not from the game files: PokeAPI data/v2/csv (commit 5ee47a9a9c1229632ec4b473a9c1c53026e005dd, fetched 2026-10-17; BSD-3-Clause) + Pokemon Showdown (MIT, commit 7244fe8e28fa8bc4d0809ae30d183c608b62bb2b) for the Legends: Z-A learnsets. For species/forms with active rows in data/pml_personal.tsv the VERIFIED game sheets always win at load time (crates/pla/src/national.rs).

# semantics: source is za|sv|swsh|lgpe|bdsp|pla|genN; method is level_up|machine|egg|tutor|form_change|special (level_up = nivel, machine = MT, egg = huevo, tutor = tutor); inherited=1 rows copy the species default form (or, for cosmetic variants, their parent pokemon row); move_id is the national PokeAPI move id (0 = Showdown-only), engine_move_id is the id inside data/pml_moves.tsv + class-a data/gen9_moves.tsv; in_engine=0 rows are summarised in moves_not_in_engine.tsv.
